periwinkle-signal.$description: Periwinkle Signal — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

deep-indigo.$description: Deep Indigo — Primary heading text, nav links, high-emphasis body — anchors the palette with near-black authority carrying a faint cool tint

storm-violet.$description: Storm Violet — Secondary text, input values, subdued body copy — sits between indigo and gray for medium-emphasis reading

slate.$description: Slate — Muted inline links, secondary metadata, caption-level annotations

fog.$description: Fog — Helper text, placeholder copy, low-emphasis labels in form and card contexts

ash.$description: Ash — Disabled states, very low-emphasis metadata

midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Body text default, high-contrast copy — the achromatic black of the system

cloud.$description: Cloud — Page canvas, hero backdrop, outer sections — slightly cool off-white that softens the entire site

paper.$description: Paper — Card surfaces, nav bar, input fills, elevated panels — true white against the off-white canvas creates a subtle lift

mist.$description: Mist — Hairline borders, card edges, divider lines — the default 1px separator

haze.$description: Haze — Stronger borders, input outlines, shadow-tinted strokes

bone.$description: Bone — Alternate surface fill for secondary cards or muted backgrounds

lilac-wash.$description: Lilac Wash — Soft tinted borders, periwinkle-derived dividers, subtle hover backgrounds

periwinkle-mist.$description: Periwinkle Mist — Pill backgrounds, tag fills, light decorative wash — the pale sibling of the brand accent

sky-tint.$description: Sky Tint — Secondary icon backgrounds, muted chart highlights

coral-ember.$description: Coral Ember — Category icon fills, chart accents, decorative highlight markers — the warm counterweight to periwinkle

coral-blush.$description: Coral Blush — Soft coral background, pastel category tag fill

mint-whisper.$description: Mint Whisper — Decorative chart fill, pastel category tag — used sparingly for icon and illustration variety

mint-veil.$description: Mint Veil — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis

object-sans.$description: Display and heading typeface — used for all headlines, subheadings, nav items, and button labels. The ultra-thin 100/300 weights at large sizes (56–80px) create the system's signature whisper-of-authority voice; tight negative tracking (-0.07em at 80px) compresses the geometric forms for a confident, almost editorial feel. Reaches up to 80px for hero statements.

helvetica-neue.$description: Body and interface text — paragraph copy, form labels, helper text, list items. Neutral and legible; deliberately quieter than the display face so headlines own the visual hierarchy. Weight 300 for light body emphasis, 400 for default, 500 for inline emphasis.
